fusions.name: Spindle Shoal
fusions.desc: Looses 4 weighted spindles in a wide fan, each dealing 3 damage, with a 25% chance per hit to leave the target [Slowed] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Weighted Seine
fusions.desc: Casts a weighted net at an enemy up to 7 tiles away, dealing 14 damage, up to 1.4 times as much at full reach. It stuns the target for 1.2 seconds and slows it by 30% for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Oiled Selvage
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 20% and your dodge chance by 25% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Slipped Mesh
fusions.desc: Every blow you avoid builds a stack on you, up to 4. At 4 they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 7% of your maximum health per stack (28% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
